subject: general
question:
Pick the odd one out.

Rectangle, Triangle, Square, Parallelogram
solution:
**Given:**

Shapes of quadrilateral (Rectangle, Square, Parallelogram) and triangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3db27ea0cc89cb19b4ba23f21be6576190fa51f233219e2feea33d77f7fed633.png] 

**Explanation:**

A quadrilateral is a plane figure that has four sides or edges, so all figures other than a triangle falls into the category of a quadrilateral.

In the above shapes, all the shapes have four sides except the triangle(which has 3 sides).

**So, the triangle is an odd shape among the given shapes.**
